name: Insurance Fraud
description: Fraud may be opportunistic (inflated claims) or organised (staged accidents, ghost brokers, fake policies). Insurers and banks may see related payments, claimants and repairers.

sources.text: Insurance Fraud Bureau (UK), published guidance on fraud trends (general)
Association of British Insurers, annual detected fraud statistics (general)
ACFE, Occupational Fraud 2024: A Report to the Nations (2024)

exposure.rationale: Claims and policy fraud through brokers (ghost broking), repairers and medical providers; claimants often contact insurers remotely.
